description: A campaign's media library in one read: the id of its cover, its battlemaps (id, title, file, upload date, dimensions, place, and the grid: hex size, offsets, orientation pointy or flat, colour, opacity as a fraction of 1, 5 feet per hex) and its illustrations (id, title, file, upload date, dimensions, ratio, place). The campaign is given as `campaign`; `campaignId`, the name of version 1, is still read when `campaign` is absent. A media without a place is listed with a null place; a media of another campaign is never listed; no campaign given lists nothing.
